question: T5: the w and n handles on a Fit button, the 3 column stop on w, and the phone least size

answer.n: A Fit button: n goes down to 2 rows, 5/2/7/8, and stays there. It comes back up a row at a time.
answer.w: w stops at 3 columns, 3/5/7/8, whatever more you pull. It comes back a column at a time.
answer.phone: A phone stops at 3 columns as well, 1/2/4/5 (134.4 wide). The first pull takes it to 3 rows, 1/2/4/9, as in ours. The text wraps at 182.8. A Fit that wraps stays at 3 rows.

ours: Desktop n and w match, every step. Phone e goes to 1 column, 1/2/4/3, in ours.
differs: Phone least width of a button: oracle 3 columns, ours 1. app/src/editor.js has leastCols 3 only when bp is desktop.
